stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to end death penalty, 1st in Middle East to do so
stories.summary: Death sentences will be replaced with life imprisonment with aggravated hard labour.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Lebanon parliament votes to end death penalty, 1st in Middle East to do so. Death sentences will be replaced with life imprisonment with aggravated hard labour. Source: Al Jazeera.
stories.headline: Lebanon parliament votes to end death penalty, 1st in Middle East to do so

opening: Death sentences will be replaced with life imprisonment with aggravated hard labour.
The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.
